changes.change: Separated upkeep removal from current-controller last-counter trigger; Oracle text and AI exclusions unchanged.

rules_reference.scope: Retained versioned rules, not a current-rules certification

excluded_drafts: The first fixture omitted the active phase-trigger registration reset. It was corrected before binding the final 23-case baseline.
The first packaged runner attempted compiler discovery inside a sanitized worker; compilation moved to the trusted parent and generated classes are verified by hash before and after execution.
An initial XML-reading implementation was rejected by Bandit. Final packaged observations use the native TestNG listener, retaining XML only as a hashed generated artifact.
limits: Strategic AI exclusions remain on both cards; mandatory rule execution is distinguished from AI casting policy.
Control layers and selected counter totals are fixed preconditions. These do not certify all preceding counter placement, control acquisition or alternate casting processes.
Copied-game cases test both a pending draw trigger and counter removal in a copied game; they do not establish every possible copied state.
The fixture uses normal four-player Commander without limited range of influence or team variants.
The packaged runner executes only the two fixed reviewed Java sources with pinned TestNG. No deck-upload path can select sources, dependencies or executable arguments.
ruling_summary: A resolving Divine Intervention draw ends a normal game without winners or losers. Only its current controller removing the last counter triggers that ability. Limited-range multiplayer uses a distinct scope and is excluded from this fixture.

catalog_source.name: Oracle Cards
catalog_source.description: A JSON file containing one Scryfall card object for each Oracle ID on Scryfall. The chosen sets for the cards are an attempt to return the most up-to-date recognizable version of the card.

full_live.failure: Whims of the Fates full-mode positive witness selected no action

planner_investigation.observation: Both previous and candidate runtimes decline the fixed seed-0 packaged full-mode Whims witness. Pinning the seed alone is not a fix; those drafts were reverted. Native rules and the 23 draw-ending packaged witnesses pass. Investigate full planner context and stochastic scoring before activation.
planner_investigation.causal_scope: The failure is reproducible before the Divine Intervention rules correction. It is not evidence of a new draw-rules regression.
planner_investigation.diagnostic_limit: The direct preview used its own explicit seed. Its improved score is not proof that the full planner used that same preview seed or context.
